source.title: Beneficial effects of creatine supplementation in dystrophic patients.
source.authors: Louis M, Lebacq J, Poortmans JR, Belpaire-Dethiou MC, Devogelaer JP, Van Hecke P, Goubel F, Francaux M.
source.version: Seven-page publisher-formatted journal article, printed pp604–610, independently identified by title/authors/journal/page range; retrieved lawfully through public UCLouvain citation_pdf_url. OpenAlex submittedVersion label is not adopted as an inspection finding.

discovery.selection: Frozen continuation selected by design/administration/function flags and fixed stratum ordering; not by favorable findings.

existing_assessment.scope: Exact PMID and DOI search within all current immutable decision objects and three existing creatine scientific JSON files; no scientific main reading of earlier trials; absence here is not absence from entire literature or catalog.

preparation.placebo_mass: Abstract describes 3 g Cr or maltodextrin daily; Methods explicitly specify creatine 3 g/day but not separate placebo mass.
preparation.cotherapy: Any other drug therapy excluded; no assigned exercise intervention described.
preparation.exposure_evidence: Table 2 plasma and urinary creatine positives support absorption; no validated tissue-specific exposure threshold or mechanistic mediation.
preparation.locator: Subjects p605; Table 2 and Blood/Urine pp607; acknowledgments p609

population.selection: Clinical diagnosis and dystrophin mutation identification after muscle biopsy; exclude other drug therapy or elbow-flexion torque below 1 N·m.
transfer_limits: selected boys without other drug therapy

design.measurements: Before and after each treatment period.
design.allocation_detail: Random assignment asserted; generation and concealment not described.
design.n_basis: Table 2 footnote n=15 except stated n=6 TJS and n=6 PCr/β-ATP; no explicit complete-pair flow or ITT/missing-data specification.
design.spectroscopy_subset: Six slimmest participants could fit scanner; anatomically selected.
design.stiffness_subset: n=6 in table; reason unreported and identity with NMR subset not established.
design.carryover: Results and Discussion explicitly report persistence of MVC and fatigue gains at end of two-month washout after creatine.
crossover_analysis_limits: No reported period or sequence model
No separate randomized first-period effect reported
Disease progression and growth may affect period pooling

hierarchy_and_statistics.sample_size_plan: No original prospective calculation recovered; Discussion gives a retrospective NMR sample-size assertion, not a prospective primary plan.
hierarchy_and_statistics.reported_method: Paired Student t test on pre/post differences; P<.05; mean ± SE.
hierarchy_and_statistics.table_contrast: Table 2 explicitly labels P-value column Placebo vs Cr. Treat as author-reported direct treatment comparisons, not inferred solely from separate within-arm significance.
hierarchy_and_statistics.analysis_uncertainty: Methods do not fully specify the construction of each Table 2 contrast; no adjusted period/sequence treatment estimate or CI is provided.
hierarchy_and_statistics.multiplicity: No multiplicity adjustment reported across 17 table outcomes and ambulatory subgroup comparisons.
hierarchy_and_statistics.locator: Statistics p606; Table 2 p607; Discussion p607

functional_tests.MVC: Elbow-flexion isometric torque, highest of three efforts.
functional_tests.fatigue: After eight-minute recovery, time maintaining 75% MVC; not a walking or activities-of-daily-living scale.
functional_tests.stiffness: Mechanical perturbations at 25% and 50% MVC; table reports 50% only.
functional_tests.narrative_within_period: Creatine MVC +15% and fatigue nearly doubled; no placebo change in MVC/fatigue. Placebo TJS approximately +25%, creatine TJS unchanged.
functional_tests.locator: Muscle Function pp605–606; Table 2 p607; Figure 1 p608

native_figures.figure1: All panels A–C and caption read: sequence-specific mean ± SE, percent of first measure; no effect sizes reconstructed from bars.
native_figures.figure2: All three paired-line outcomes/caption read for n=5 ambulatory subgroup; within-treatment P labels retained without interaction inference.

metabolic_reporting.table_result: PCr/β-ATP P=.04 under Placebo vs Cr, n=6.
metabolic_reporting.narrative_result: Approximately 8% creatine-period rise did not reach significance under pre/post test; repeated nonsignificant wording in Discussion.
metabolic_reporting.adjudication: Potentially different comparisons; exact relationship unresolved. Preserve both, do not choose one or infer mediation.

ambulatory_bone_subset.population: Wheelchair-independent throughout study; includes DMD and BMD.
ambulatory_bone_subset.contrast: Within-treatment paired tests; no reported subgroup treatment interaction or direct subgroup treatment estimate.
ambulatory_bone_subset.abstract_wording: Approximately 3% bone-density increase and NTx decline to about one third after Cr.
ambulatory_bone_subset.wording_limit: Retain exact main-text NTx ratio values separately without numerical harmonization of abstract wording.

nulls_and_limits.lean_mass: Discussion says no lean-body-mass increase, citing Table 2, but that table contains body mass rather than a separate lean-mass row. Do not relabel body mass as lean mass or tissue renewal.
nulls_and_limits.mechanism: Common growth-signaling and activity/bone explanations are hypotheses; no mediation, renewal, dystrophin repair or BUBR1 result.

harms.author_report: No cramps, diarrhea or other side effects and no adverse hepatic/renal effects observed.
harms.laboratory_results: Creatinine, albumin and listed enzymes NS under Table 2 contrasts.
limits: No systematic adverse-event collection schedule described
No equivalence testing or long-term safety inference

planning_and_notices.ethics: University medicine faculty ethics approval and written consent from boys/both parents.
planning_and_notices.registration: No identifier in main. Two saved current ClinicalTrials.gov searches (exact PMID/DOI and exact title/investigator) returned empty studies arrays. Not proof of universal nonregistration.
planning_and_notices.supplement: No separate supplement identified in main or bounded source search; not proof of none.
planning_and_notices.linked_notices: No comment/correction field in saved exact Europe PMC metadata; Crossref relation empty/update-to absent. No exhaustive notice search claim.
funding: Fonds National de la Recherche Scientifique, Belgium
planning_and_notices.author_funding: Magali Louis: Fonds du Patrimoine pour la recherche médicale, Université Catholique de Louvain.
planning_and_notices.COI: No separate conflict declaration identified; not proof of no conflicts.

competitive_assessment.conclusion: Retain reported controlled functional positives as a substantive preparation-specific compensation comparison, with major crossover, selection, multiplicity and reporting limits.
competitive_assessment.criteria: Same function/exposure/renewal/chromosome-fidelity bar as other candidates; BUBR1 mediation is additionally necessary only for restoration claims.
competitive_assessment.new_appraisal_or_alias: None proposed; later source append/refinement to existing creatine assessment only.
competitive_assessment.prior_trials: Earlier DMD/FSHD, inflammatory-myopathy and healthy-aging evidence remains distinct and unchanged; no pooling or duplicate primary-reading credit.
